title: Dubai NO2 drop leads Brent higher
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Dubai CAMS NO2 20d z-score below -1.5 (Gulf refining/production slowdown proxy) leads Brent higher by 4 days (+); trade long BZ=F 7d [airquality.dubai.cams_no2 -> finance.BZ=F.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.dubai.cams_no2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Dubai CAMS NO2 20d z-score above 1.0 (Gulf refining/production pickup) leads Brent lower by 3 days (-); trade short BZ=F 3d - sign reversal of R2-0013 whose long rule had negative excess return pre-war and only a war-sample edge [airquality.dubai.cams_no2 -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0013)
